title: 第15章 灵税劫修第16章 抵达云城
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
顾安将黑鳞马收入灵兽袋，随着林长风二人缓步上山。
正午的阳光洒下点点碎金，枫叶在强光里褪去含蓄，变成跃动的火舌，将红枫山映成一座红色的火山。当山风掠过林梢，数万片枫叶齐齐起舞，美丽而热烈。
漫山红遍，层林尽染。
这红元枫是一阶下品灵树，林家也只有一十三颗，产出些红枫灵液，作锻体之用，颇受欢迎，当然，眼前这些只是些普通枫树，真正红元枫被林家种在山顶。
行至山腰，见一片房屋依山而建，连绵不绝，只是林家只有九人，怎么建了这么多。
林青松似乎看出顾安的疑惑，出言解释道：“顾道友别看这么多屋子，都是给凡俗族人住的，我林家人丁不旺，从建立起就是混居。”
顾安恍然，他在青元宗里没见过凡人，下意识地没往这方面想。
见林青松有些失落，顾安安慰道：“我看林家年轻一辈有许多有灵根者，想必以后能壮大林家。”
这可不是顾安乱说，林家有路字辈老族长一人，修为练气后期，长字辈修士两人，一个练气中期一个炼气初期，青字辈足有六人，甚至有一人踏入练气中期，年龄似乎才二十岁，在这等小族中已经很不错了。
林青松苦笑一声，“谢顾道友吉言了。”
林长风也喟然一叹：“青松你也别想太多，青枫是三灵根，他修为高了，林家才能更好，福泽我等。”
顾安闻言心中有所猜测，但是别人家事，不好置喙。
不知不觉来到山顶，见有几座庭院林立，顾安被引至最顶上一座。
林长风上前拍门，“族长，青元宗顾仙师前来拜访。”
木门无风自动，向两侧打开，顾安只感到一阵微弱的灵气涌动，可见其人对灵力控制细致入微。
“哈哈，顾道友光临寒舍，真是蓬荜生辉啊！”
一阵爽朗的大笑传来，一锦袍老者已大步走到跟前。
“晚辈见过林族长，昔日一别，林族长仍是风采依旧。”来人正是林氏族长林路平，顾安一拱手，说道。
“顾道友谬赞了，来，请进。”林路平引着顾安步入正堂。
这正堂内一张长木桌子摆在中间，上首一张太师椅，两侧各有四张，看起来像是议事的地方。

顾安在右手第一张椅子坐下，林路平坐在首位，在奉上茶后，林长风和林青松二人被林路平赶了出去，堂中只剩下两人。
林路平用茶盖扫了扫茶汤，开口道：“顾道友此行可是来收取灵税的？”
顾安点了点头，对林路平知道此事并不奇怪，他没事又不会来拜访红枫山，再加上已是七月，并不奇怪。
“还记得去年此时褚道友也是前来，我们也算是好友，不知褚道友近来可好。”
顾安略一迟疑，说道：“我与褚师兄并不相熟，不知其近况。”
林路平好似也就随口一问，不太在意，反而开口介绍起林家产出，“说与顾道友知晓，今年林家产红枫树汁十五斤多些，金云米则是收了四千二百斤。”
“青字辈老五林青萍突破炼气二层，其余人修为没什么变化。”
content_en:
Gu An put the black scale horse into the spirit animal bag and followed Lin Changfeng and the others up the mountain slowly.
The midday sun sheds little bits of gold, and the maple leaves lose their subtlety in the strong light and turn into leaping tongues of fire, reflecting the Red Maple Mountain into a red volcano. When the mountain wind passes through the forest tops, tens of thousands of maple leaves dance together, beautiful and enthusiastic.
The mountains are covered with red, and the forests are dyed.
This red maple is a first-order low-grade spiritual tree, and the Lin family only has thirteen of them. It produces some red maple spiritual fluid, which is used for body training and is quite popular. Of course, these are just ordinary maples in front of you. The real red maple is planted on the top of the mountain by the Lin family.
Walking to the mountainside, I saw a row of houses built along the mountain. However, there were only nine people in the Lin family, so why did they build so many houses.
Lin Qingsong seemed to see Gu An's doubts and explained: "Gu Daoyou, don't look at so many houses, they are all for ordinary people to live in. My Lin family is not prosperous, and they have been living together since the establishment."
Gu An suddenly realized that he had never seen a mortal in Qingyuan Sect, so he subconsciously did not think about it.
Seeing that Lin Qingsong was a little disappointed, Gu An comforted him: "I think there are many people with spiritual roots in the younger generation of the Lin family, who will surely strengthen the Lin family in the future."
This is not Gu An's nonsense. The Lin family has an old patriarch of the Lu generation who is in the late stage of Qi training, two monks of the Long generation, one in the middle stage and one in the early stage of Qi practice. There are six people in the Qing generation, and there is even one person who has entered the middle stage of Qi training. He seems to be only twenty years old, which is already very good among such a small clan.
Lin Qingsong smiled bitterly and said, "Thank you, fellow Taoist Gu, for your kind words."
Lin Changfeng also sighed: "Qingsong, don't think too much, Qingfeng has three spiritual roots. The higher his cultivation level, the better the Lin family will be. We will wait for Fuze."
When Gu An heard this, he had some guesses in his mind, but it was not easy to comment on other people's family matters.
Arriving at the top of the mountain unknowingly, he saw several courtyards lined up, and Gu An was led to the top one.
Lin Changfeng stepped forward and knocked on the door, "Clan leader, Master Gu Xian of Qingyuan Sect is here to visit."
The wooden door automatically opened without wind and opened to both sides. Gu An only felt a weak surge of spiritual energy, which showed that he controlled his spiritual power meticulously.
"Haha, Taoist friend Gu has come to visit me, it's so radiant!"
A burst of hearty laughter came, and an old man in brocade robes strode forward.
"Juniors have met Patriarch Lin. After seeing each other again, Patriarch Lin is still as charming as ever." The person who came was none other than Lin Luping, the patriarch of the Lin clan. Gu An cupped his hands and said.
"Fellow Taoist Gu, you are so complimentary. Come on, please come in." Lin Luping led Gu An into the main hall.
There is a long wooden table in the middle of the main hall, with an imperial chair at the top and four on each side. It looks like a place for discussion.
Gu An sat down on the first chair on his right, and Lin Luping sat at the top. After serving tea, Lin Changfeng and Lin Qingsong were kicked out by Lin Luping, leaving only two people in the hall.
Lin Luping swept the tea soup with a tea lid and said, "Did Fellow Taoist Gu come here to collect spiritual taxes?"
Gu An nodded, not surprised that Lin Luping knew about this. He would not come to visit Hongfeng Mountain if he had nothing to do, and it was already July, so it was not surprising.
"I still remember that Fellow Daoist Chu also came here at this time last year. We are also considered good friends. I wonder how Fellow Daoist Chu is doing these days."
Gu An hesitated for a moment and said, "I'm not familiar with Senior Brother Chu, so I don't know his current situation."
Lin Luping seemed to just ask casually and didn't care much. Instead, he introduced the Lin family's output, "As I know with fellow Taoist Gu, the Lin family produced more than 15 kilograms of red maple sap this year, and 4,200 kilograms of golden cloud rice."
"Lin Qingping, the fifth-eldest member of the Qing generation, broke through to the second level of Qi refining, and the rest of the people have no changes in their cultivation."
